about: Package 3a (the instruments of Tempo, Seed, Takes, the Sampler, Repaint, Timbre reference, Latent & correction and Performance trades): every scenario this package makes runnable, each with what it exercises. 34-instruments.mjs holds on the concept page too (--page hotstep-tiers.html: all pass there). Entries marked `waiting` need a package built in parallel (4: the prompt card; 6: Latest's songs and the go bar; 8: tooltips). `excluded` lists the concept's scenarios that exercise these instruments and cannot pass as written, each with why.

scenarios.why: keyWheel: the .tempo housing beside the LCD it holds, the two rings and Auto, keys spelled as a musician spells them (G-D-25), a segment chooses and the LCD spells it, the arrows walk from the key in force and focus follows, Enter chooses; the LCD alone at Quick and on Stable Audio 3.
tapTempo: the first tap arms it (AGAIN), the second sets the BPM off auto, a run of taps is one step, the button rests after the run.

capChips: a chip goes into the prompt as an item, another of its group replaces it, a key is a group of its own, a tempo inside a sentence is never cut (S-04), pressed again it comes out; each press a step named for the chip.

splitFlap: ten cells with RANDOM in the middle, Roll once keeps a fresh seed and the cells land right-aligned, the step named as the seed, the field in the cells' place takes a typed seed (spaces ignored), the lock, the LM seed's link with the planner on the desk, Random each time carries the changed mark at Quick.

savedSeeds: nothing to save while random (said), loading a saved seed keeps it and marks its row, the form updates a saved one with Undo in its toast, a star puts it first, search by tag, Escape clears the search, a random saved seed is never the one loaded (L-22).

takesReels: the VRAM a count costs, pointing at a reel previews its count, a reel sets it and the slider keeps focus, the arrows and Home move it and end the preview (L-32), MiniMax-Music3's four reels and its per-extra-take cost.

samplerScope: a dot a step, the curve follows the schedule and its shape's slider, the CFG window's band and the hatched cutoff, the read-out's words with its numbers in bold and its way to the cutoff, custom timesteps drawn and said, native sampling said.
samplerScope at Lab: the CFG interval's two handles never pass each other (A-31), a window with no step turns guidance off and says so, a handle follows the hand.
latentCurve: grey and green as one curve at rest, the green follows the shift, with the XY pad laid over it.

repaintRegion: the song and the region in its times, a key moves it (a step named in the song's times, Q-24), Shift moves its end, End keeps its length (L-36), a plain click outside leaves it (A-32), a drag inside carries it whole as one step, the spoken range follows.

recentRefs and timbreBlend: the recent files under their label, the blend standing back with its reason while there is no track, a recent file loads as the reference (a step named for it), a key nudges the blend and the circles say it in percent, more than three recent files: two and the rest behind one button (L-21).
The XY pad's corner words outside the pad (A-07), as Performance trades shows them (the slice's xyPad, fixed here).

The knob as the Sampler shows it (the slice's knob, fixed here): the auto pill lit and the auto colour (A-11, L-11), turning leaves auto, the pill puts it back, a symbol label (α, β) printed as written.
tapTempo and keyWheel: a run of taps is one step (L-22), a run of arrow presses on the wheel is one step (L-25).
The key's changed mark on Tempo's LCD (KEY), the takes' on the reels' LCD and the blend's under the circles, through a re-render and a tier switch (A-06).
The Sampler's knobs, among them Shift with its auto pill (turning it leaves auto).
Tempo's BPM in its LCD row and the Sampler's Steps: a word written straight into the box is refused and put back (package 1's number box, fixed here: package 2 excluded it for that).
The Sampler's guidance knob typed into, in the Sampler's well beside its scope.
One changed mark per setting on the Seed and Tempo tiles (the lock, the key).
The Sampler's well under its scope: the knobs share it evenly.
The scope, the reels' LCD and Tempo's LCD keep to the column's edges.
The scope's power switch (Lua plugins), the scope's child, stays with its engine.
keyWheel (a click and every key), tapTempo, Beat I/O, auto-trim, and the prompt chips.
takesReels: a reel sets the takes, pointing previews, leaving puts it back; a run that will not fit is said under Generate.
repaintRegion: a plain click outside keeps the region (A-32), a drag inside carries it, the spoken range follows.
repaintRegion: Home and End move the region to the song's ends, its length kept (L-36).
repaintRegion: a key and a drag are steps named in the song's times (Q-24), Ctrl+Z puts the region back and leaves Repaint (L-01).
repaintRegion from the song menu's Repaint a region: arrows, Shift, a drag that draws a new region, removing Repaint drops the source (RA-23, fix-desk: derive/desk.ts leavesWith).
capChips on Stable Audio 3 and HeartMuLa, and the length's range per engine.
The reels' and the knobs' tips open clear of their read-outs (L-06).
